scope: 50 planned images;30 charts and20 German synthetic invoices; all120 primary field labels
method: Independent manual pixel inspection plus deterministic comparisons to cases gold. Four original diagnostic invoices inspected earlier were matched to final copies by source ID and image SHA256; remaining16 read individually. All30 charts read in five six-image sheets. No model output accessed.

requested_prompt_fixes.reason: chart012/test137 contains only positive plotted values; old positive AND negative wording is false.
requested_prompt_fixes.recommended_de: Waagerechte Balken mit einer Reihe und Positiv-/Negativ-Legende

requested_prompt_fixes.reason: All3 examples use a stacked vertical column; prefer Säule to German Balken.

limitations: Assessment is at readable original image resolution; model processor downscaling may impair readability.
Gold verifies displayed text and chart structure, not legal correctness or finance truth.
Some pie legend labels are clipped but entry counts are visually unambiguous.
